paracetamol.name: Paracetamol 500mg
paracetamol.use: Fever, mild to moderate pain — as listed on leaflet
paracetamol.storage: Store in cool, dry place below 30°C
paracetamol.warning: Do not exceed leaflet dose. If allergic, seek pharmacist advice.

cetirizine.name: Cetirizine 10mg
cetirizine.use: Allergy symptoms like sneezing, runny nose
cetirizine.warning: May cause sleepiness. Avoid driving if drowsy.
